definitions.explanation: A thin, long-legged insect that skates over the surface of ponds and still water.

examples.english: There are water striders in the pond.

examples.japanese: アメンボ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すいすい⟦{滑|すべ}っている→滑る：01230_suberu⟧。
examples.english: A water strider is gliding smoothly over the water.

examples.japanese: アメンボ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沈|しず}ま→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}いていられる→浮く：00413_uku⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the fine hairs on its feet, a water strider can stay on the water without sinking.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
The name is said to come from ⟦{飴|あめ}→飴：00687_ame⟧ (candy), for a sweet smell the insect gives off.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many Japanese know it from the pronunciation drill poem by {北原白秋|きたはらはくしゅう} that begins あめんぼ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧なアイウエオ.

WRITING:
The kanji spellings {水黽|あめんぼ} and {水馬|あめんぼ} are rare; katakana is the norm.
